canonical_project: Yamal data centers on Gazprom production sites
owner: Crypto Energy / Gazprom / Government of Yamalo-Nenets Autonomous Okrug
notes: YNAO, Gazprom, and Crypto Energy signed a PMEF agreement to develop energy supply for digital infrastructure and place data centers at Gazprom production facilities using spare generation and low-pressure gas from mature fields; Yamal is described as the pilot region.
